settings.title: Details
settings.body: High-shine, non-sticky lip gloss formula, or hypoallergenic nickel-free plating on every piece of jewelry. Adjustable clasps for a comfortable, custom fit. Made in small batches, hand-finished before it ships.

settings.title: Care instructions
settings.body: Jewelry: keep dry, store in the pouch when not worn, avoid perfume and lotion contact. Lip gloss: keep cool, avoid direct sunlight, close cap tightly after each use.

settings.title: Shipping & returns
settings.body: Ships in 1–2 days from Akron, OH. Free shipping on orders over $50. 30-day returns on unworn, unopened items.

settings.headline: Made to shine.
settings.body:
Every piece is small-batch and hand-finished — nothing mass-produced, nothing rushed. Our lip gloss formula is high-shine, not sticky, so it actually feels good to wear all day. Our jewelry is nickel-free and made to hold up to everyday life, not just a night out.

Redkisses personally checks every batch before it hits the shop. If it doesn't shine, it doesn't get listed.

settings.heading: Literally flawless gloss
settings.quote: Got the Hot Pink and the pigment is unreal — not sticky at all, and the shine lasts for hours. Redkisses texted me back about a shade match within minutes — that level of service is unreal.

settings.heading: My anklet still sparkles
settings.quote: I'm three months into wearing this anklet daily — showered, slept, everything in it. Still catching light exactly like day one. Easily worth double what I paid.

settings.heading: Packaging was so cute
settings.quote: The gift box alone made me feel like I spent $200 even though I didn't. My custom bracelet is exactly what I asked for, down to the clasp.

settings.heading: Great but took a minute to ship
settings.quote: Took 3 days to arrive instead of 2 but the shades are top notch, great tint and fit. Would absolutely reorder.
